{{Quote|This planet's freedom fighters finally have the advantage! And the court's pro-Empire troops are scared.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 89">[[Star Wars (1977) 89|''Star Wars'' (1977) 89]]</ref>}}
The '''Solay Royal Court''' was the ruling organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solay]]. For at least fifty years, the court oppressed the native populace, leading to a small rebel movement led by the rebel leader, [[Raggold]]. Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the leader of the court was [[King/Legends|King]] [[Blackart]], a tyrannical [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]. The royal court was a vassal of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who supported the court and their King during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The court was defended by the [[Solay Royal Guard]], and the guard were also supportive of the Empire.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and the news that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had been killed, the revolutionary movement on Solay gained momentum. Unknown to the court, an [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] had financed the rebels, hoping to remove the court so that he could rule directly over the planet. Raggold, the leader of the rebels, accepted a bribe from the Imperials to lead a final charge on the royal court and take the King captive. The plot succeeded, and the royal court was overthrown. King Blackart was captured and imprisoned, but he soon escaped off-world. Just as the Empire had planned, they moved in and swept away the successful rebel movement, taking control of Solay from the rebels.
